facts.conditions: PTC3 protects board-b's final -12V output (downstream of U8 CJ7912), whose rail current budget magnitude is 0.8A per CLAUDE.md Project Overview ('-12V/0.8A'). Margin = fact-ptc3-ihold (1.50A) minus the 0.8A rail current budget.
facts.locator: CALCULATED from fact-ptc3-ihold and the project's -12V/0.8A rail current budget (CLAUDE.md Project Overview)

facts.conditions: PTC3 sits on board-b's final -12V output (downstream of U8 CJ7912 -12V LDO), so its nominal continuous applied voltage magnitude is 12V. Margin = fact-ptc3-vmax (16 Vdc) minus the 12V nominal rail magnitude; this is the tightest voltage margin of board-b's three PTCs and does not by itself account for switching-rail ripple or transients upstream of the LDO.
facts.locator: CALCULATED from fact-ptc3-vmax and the project's -12V nominal output rail (CLAUDE.md Project Overview and Technical Architecture; board-b PTC3 downstream of U8 CJ7912)
